title: New Year’s Eve Trip
description: A trip to celebrate New Year’s Eve. Ena and the members of the OEC visit Si Qi Pavilion to perform year-end shrine visits. Meanwhile, Rin goes on a solo trip to the southern region and ends up meeting Nadeshiko at her grandma’s house.

title: Lake Yamanaka Trip
description: Ena, Aki, and Aoi visit several places in Fujiyoshida and Yamanakako, then go camping at Lake Yamanaka.

title: Nadeshiko’s Shizuoka Solo Camp Trip
description: This is Nadeshiko’s first solo trip. She decides to visit several places in Shizuoka Prefecture. At the same time, Rin is planning her own trip but cancels it to visit Nadeshiko instead, because she’s worried about her.

title: Cape Izu Trip
description: The final trip of Season 2. All the characters go on a journey to Cape Izu for camping and studying various geospots. Rin rides her bike, while the others travel by car, driven by Toba-sensei. This is their first multi-night trip. During this trip, they also celebrate Nadeshiko’s and Aoi’s birthdays.

title: Season 2 Extra
description: A short addition about various places that appear in Season 2 but are not included as part of the main trips.
